from plotly import graph_objs as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

edits.new:
# Plotly 7 removed create_distplot. Preserve the two probability-
            # density histograms and their sample rugs using public trace APIs.
            groups = distribution[label]
            labels = [str(label), "other"]
            colors = [self.color_options.primary_color, self.color_options.secondary_color]
            pred_distr = make_subplots(
                rows=2, cols=1, shared_xaxes=True,
                row_heights=[0.8, 0.2], vertical_spacing=0.04,
            )
            for position, (values, group_label, color) in enumerate(zip(groups, labels, colors)):
                pred_distr.add_trace(
                    go.Histogram(
                        x=values, name=group_label, legendgroup=group_label,
                        histnorm="probability density", xbins=dict(size=0.05),
                        marker_color=color, opacity=0.7,
                    ), row=1, col=1,
                )
                pred_distr.add_trace(
                    go.Scatter(
                        x=values, y=[position] * len(values), mode="markers",
                        name=group_label, legendgroup=group_label, showlegend=False,
                        marker=dict(color=color, symbol="line-ns-open"),
                    ), row=2, col=1,
                )
            pred_distr.update_layout(barmode="overlay")
            pred_distr.update_yaxes(tickvals=[0, 1], ticktext=labels, row=2, col=1)
